events.what_it_is: DedCool's first NYC cafe and retail pop-up, celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe drinks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and shopping.
events.what_is_free: Public entry and fragrance sampling; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a special gift. Secondary coverage also reports complimentary coffee/snacks at the pop-up.
events.caveats: A Partiful RSVP is available, but current sources describe the retail pop-up as open to the public and do not establish RSVP as required for entry. First-50 gift is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. Arrive early if the first-50 gift matters.

events.address: 50 2nd Avenue and 184 7th Avenue South, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Three-day Cake Pop Hair Dryer launch takeover at Lil Sweet Treat locations with sweet treats, photo moments, giveaways and Conair accessories.
events.what_is_free: Open public entry, sweet-treat activation and hair accessories while supplies last. Cake Pop Hair Dryers are offered with purchase to the first 100 visitors each day.
events.caveats: The hair-dryer giveaway requires purchase and is limited to the first 100 visitors each day; do not describe the dryer itself as a no-purchase freebie. Accessories are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 11 AM–11 PM daily at both the East Village and West Village Lil Sweet Treat locations.

events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU Beauty IRL pop-up with products, new launches, immersive activations and community programming.
events.what_is_free: Admission is advertised via RSVP; specific complimentary product/giveaway inventory is not established strongly enough to promise.
events.caveats: Current listings say RSVP now but do not establish organizer approval or door-discretion language. Keep as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required unless the registration page says otherwise.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 11 AM–5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St.

events.what_it_is: One-day Kilian Paris pop-up celebrating the fragrance house's cocktails collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples; exclusive gifts are tied to purchase and available while supplies last.
events.caveats: Gifts with purchase are not no-purchase freebies. Complimentary mocktails/samples are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 12–8 PM at 401 W 14th St.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: Dunkin' sampling truck at the Seaport with seasonal drink samples and branded swag.
events.what_is_free: Samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples and swag are explicitly while supplies last.
